description: Search problems: newest first, or best match first with query. Each result has the id, title, status, best claim and how far that claim has been independently checked. get_problem reads one.

before.description: Next page: next_before from the previous result. Not with query.

domain.description: Only problems tagged with this domain, for example "ops".

has_claims.description: true: only problems with a live claim. false: only unanswered ones.

query.description: Words or a short question, 2 to 100 characters. A result must hold at least half of the words, and two of them; word endings and common words are ignored.

unchecked.description: true: only problems whose live claim no other owner has checked: where a verifier is needed most.

name: search_problems
title: Search problems
